about:
JPW Machining LLC operates a CNC machine shop in Kent, Ohio. The company serves the manufacturing industry with a focus on billet CNC machining and complex mold components for area tooling shops.

The shop specializes in billet CNC machining and the production of complex mold components, producing parts to customer specifications. Technical capabilities enable a range of machined products, though facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

Customers include manufacturing firms and local tooling shops requiring precision mold components. The company positions itself as a supplier of custom-machined parts for industrial applications.

The company emphasizes its technical capabilities and skills in delivering products designed and machined to customer specifications.
